candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement `pot += msg.value;` so the pot is never credited with the ticket amount.
Remove the statement `pot = 0;` so the pot is not reset after a winning play.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot = msg.value;` so the pot is overwritten instead of accumulated.
Replace `pot = 0;` with `pot += FEE_AMOUNT;` so the winner also adds the fee back to the pot instead of clearing it.
Remove the statement that adds the ticket payment to the pot, so pot no longer grows on losing plays.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot = msg.value;` so the pot is overwritten rather than accumulated.
Remove `pot = 0;` so the pot is not reset after a winning play.
Change the winning condition from `random == 0` to `random == 1`, altering when the pot is paid out and reset.
Change the modulo from `% 2` to `% 3`, making random able to equal 2 so wins occur with a different probability.
